quotations.english: this is not a foolish saying

source_text: dwol-líc; def. se -líca, seó, ðæt -líce; adj. Foolish, erring, heretical; stultus, hær&e-short;t&i-short;cus :-- Nis ðis nán dwollíc sagu this is not a foolish saying, Jud. 15, 19. Hý adwæsedon ða dwollícan lára they extinguished the heretical doctrines, L. Ælf. C. 33; Th. ii. 356, 11.
